subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct with respect to displacement reaction?

options.text: A chemical reaction in which a single compound is formed.
A less electronegative non-metal displaces a less electronegative metal from its aqueous solution.
A more reactive metal displaces a less reactive metal from its aqueous solution.
A less reactive metal displaces a more reactive metal from its aqueous solution.

solution:
The correct answer is __**A more reactive metal displaces a less reactive metal from its aqueous solution**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A displacement reaction is a type of reaction in which part of one reactant is replaced by another reactant.
 
• There are two types of displacement reactions.
 
 
• Single displacement reactions: These are those reactions in which one reactant replaces part of the other 
 
• Fe + CuSO4 → FeSO4 + Cu
 
• Double displacement reactions: These are those reactions in which the cations and anions in the reactants switch partners to form products.
 
• AgNO3 + NaCl → AgCl + NaNO3
 
 
 
• A displacement reaction is also known as a replacement reaction or a metathesis reaction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__Explanation:__

 
• If Copper metal is dipped in the Iron sulphate solution the reaction will not take place because Copper is less reactive than Iron and it will not displace the Copper from the Iron sulphate.

 
 
• ​Cu + FeSO4 → NO Reaction
 
 
 
• If Iron metal is dipped in the Copper sulphate solution the reaction will take place because Iron is more reactive than copper and it will displace the Iron from the Iron sulphate solution to form Copper and Iron sulphate.
 
 
• Fe + CuSO4 → FeSO4 + Cu
 
 
 
• ​If Magnesium metal is dipped in the Zinc sulphate solution the reaction will take place because Magnesium is more reactive than Zinc and it will displace the Zinc from the Zinc sulphate solution to form Zinc and Magnesium sulphate.​
 
 
• 
 
Mg + ZnSO4 → Zn + MgSO4 ​

 
 
 
 
• 
 
​​If Aluminium metal is dipped in the Copper sulphate solution the reaction will take place because Aluminium is more reactive than Copper and it will displace the Copper from the copper sulphate solution to form Copper and Aluminium sulphate.

 
 
• 
 
​Al + CuSO4 → Cu + AlSO4
